subject: resources.records

recordTypes.summary: One external account, platform, shared asset, or registry the organization uses and administers.

fields.summary: One factual explanation of what the resource is used for.
A non-secret governed access or administration reference.
The exact date of the most recent separately evidenced validation.

content.summary: Optional governed usage notes may be retained without secrets or credential values.

limitations: Credential values, tokens, passwords, one-time codes, private invite material, and raw provider responses are outside this model.
The governed context.resources vocabulary artifact owns the exact current resource term and definition.
A resource record grants no account access, provider permission, validation result, write, disclosure, or execution authority.
